description: An object argument with a null attribute but without another attribute of the type is an error
notes: The spec's call rules make an argument that doesn't match its parameter's type an error, and the object type {x = dynamic} doesn't match {x = list(string), y = string}. But the spec also says automatic conversion is attempted when a value doesn't match what an operation expects, and its conversion rules convert an object to an object type with more attributes by filling them with null, which would give {x = null, y = null}. hashicorp/hcl converts arguments, but go-cty's object conversion requires every attribute of the target type that isn't optional (conversionObjectToObject in cty/convert/conversion_object.go), so the call fails.
